title: 聖伯納山隧道~Great St Bernard Tunnel
focus: 高山入口、雙向交通與雙控制室協調~Alpine portals, bidirectional traffic and control-room coordination
summary: 聖伯納山隧道營運者列長5798公尺，並說明兩端高山入口與全天有人值守的控制室。1964年開通的背景使其適合學習既有公路隧道長期更新。本課將洞口氣候、雙向車流、通風、耐久及跨境資訊交接串成完整工程問題，避免把洞內性能與引道服務切割。~The operator describes a 5798 m tunnel with high-altitude portals and continuously staffed control rooms at both ends. Its 1964 opening provides a setting for long-term renewal of an existing road tunnel. The course connects portal climate, bidirectional traffic, ventilation, durability and cross-border information handover rather than isolating tunnel performance from approach service.

units.anchor: 路線里程與端點~Alignment chainage and endpoints
units.title: 服務邊界與路線代價~Service boundaries and alignment cost
units.mechanism: 聖伯納山洞口和覆蓋引道共同提供高山通行，教材將隧道長度與雪季接近路段分開比較。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。~Portals and covered approaches jointly provide alpine access; distinguish tunnel length from winter approach sections. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
units.model: 原創教學假設：長度=16.8 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=16.8 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為18.48 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: length=16.8 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=16.8 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 18.48 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 核對相同端點下的洞內、引道和等待時間。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check tunnel, approach and waiting time between equal endpoints. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只評洞內時間會漏掉入口管制或引道封閉的服務中斷。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。~In-tunnel time omits service interruption at approach closures or entrance controls. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.
units.misconception: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。~The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
units.practice: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：核對相同端點下的洞內、引道和等待時間。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。~For Great St Bernard Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Check tunnel, approach and waiting time between equal endpoints. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

units.anchor: 風道摩擦壓損~Duct friction loss
units.title: 通風網路與壓力損失~Ventilation network and pressure loss
units.mechanism: 兩端高程與氣象不同使自然壓差影響雙向隧道風流，研究相同風機設定下季節變化。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。~Different portal elevations and weather create natural pressure differences in bidirectional operation, even with unchanged fan settings. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans. Switching a branch redistributes the network rather than simply adding rated flows. Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target.
units.model: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=980 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.1 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=35.3168 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為42.7333 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=980 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.1 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=35.3168 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 42.7333 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 同步量測兩端氣壓溫度與洞內風向。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Synchronise portal pressure and temperature with internal airflow direction. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 季節反向風若當感測器故障，會漏掉真實邊界變化。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。~Seasonally reversed flow mistaken for sensor failure hides real boundary change. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air.
units.misconception: 風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。~Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
units.practice: 本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：同步量測兩端氣壓溫度與洞內風向。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。~For Great St Bernard Tunnel, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Synchronise portal pressure and temperature with internal airflow direction. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.

units.title: 視覺適應與路面亮度~Visual adaptation and pavement luminance
units.mechanism: 高山洞口明暗背景可快速改變，聖伯納山教學檢查積雪反射與路面亮度的不同角色。駕駛從洞外進入洞內時視覺適應需要時間，照度並不等同從駕駛視角看到的亮度。路面反射、濕度、燈具配光及背景對比共同影響辨識；朗伯模型只示範理想漫反射，不能直接制定入口段燈具間距或真實道路安全值。~Bright alpine portal backgrounds can change quickly; distinguish snow reflection from pavement luminance. Driver adaptation takes time when entering a tunnel, and illuminance is not the luminance seen from the driving position. Pavement reflection, wetness, luminaire distribution and background contrast affect detection. A Lambertian model illustrates ideal diffuse reflection only; it cannot establish entrance-zone spacing or actual road-safety limits without photometric and operational assessment.
units.model: 原創教學假設：照度=104 lx；反射率=0.22 無因次。L=ρE/π=7.28293 cd/m²。僅把照度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為8.01122 cd/m²。邊界：理想朗伯漫反射，不是真實濕路面亮度；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: illuminance=104 lx; reflectance=0.22 dimensionless. L=ρE/π=7.28293 cd/m². Increasing only illuminance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 8.01122 cd/m². Boundary: Ideal Lambertian reflection, not actual wet-road luminance. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 在不同天空與積雪背景下量測入口視角亮度。以駕駛視角的亮度量測配合照度網格，分別檢查乾濕路面與燈具衰減，保留外部天空條件。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Measure entrance-view luminance under different sky and snow backgrounds. Combine driver-view luminance with illuminance grids, checking dry and wet pavement and lamp depreciation while preserving exterior sky conditions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 僅按洞內照度設定可能漏掉洞外高亮背景的適應需求。照度平均值合格仍可能存在低亮度障礙區或眩光，感測器沾污也會使調光系統低估外界亮度。~Interior illuminance alone misses adaptation to a bright external background. Acceptable average illuminance can coexist with dark obstacles or glare, while sensor contamination may bias adaptive lighting controls.
units.misconception: 照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。~Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect.
units.practice: 本案「漫反射亮度」的交付需回答：在不同天空與積雪背景下量測入口視角亮度。將視角、路面狀態和光度校正連同量測交付，照明調整需按核准場景測試，不把理想反射公式當驗收標準。~For Great St Bernard Tunnel, the diffuse luminance handover must address the following evidence: Measure entrance-view luminance under different sky and snow backgrounds. Hand over viewing geometry, pavement state and photometric calibration; test changes against approved scenarios rather than treating ideal reflection as an acceptance criterion.

units.anchor: 拘束溫度應變~Restrained thermal strain
units.title: 溫度拘束與構件裂縫~Thermal restraint and component cracking
units.mechanism: 高山入口溫度循環影響混凝土與接縫，教材分開線膨脹拘束和凍融含水條件。厚壁構件在水化升溫後冷卻，若相鄰構件或基座限制收縮，熱應變會轉為拉應力。抗壓強度達標不等於抗裂合格，因為彈性模數成熟、徐變、溫度梯度與澆置順序都影響實際拘束；完全拘束彈性估算只能當量級上限比較。~Portal temperature cycles affect concrete and joints; separate restrained expansion from moisture-dependent freeze-thaw behaviour. A thick element cools after hydration, and restraint from adjacent pours or its base converts contraction into tension. Compressive-strength compliance does not establish crack resistance because modulus development, creep, gradients and pour sequence influence restraint. A fully restrained elastic estimate is therefore a scale bound, not a prediction of actual cracking or residual stress.
units.model: 原創教學假設：線膨脹係數=1e-05 K⁻¹；溫差=22 K；彈性模數=25 GPa。σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=5.5 MPa。僅把溫差增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為6.05 MPa。邊界：完全拘束線彈性量級，未含徐變開裂和拘束鬆弛；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: expansion coefficient=1e-05 K⁻¹; temperature difference=22 K; elastic modulus=25 GPa. σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=5.5 MPa. Increasing only temperature difference by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 6.05 MPa. Boundary: Fully restrained linear-elastic scale without creep, cracking or restraint relaxation. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 將表面與內部溫度配對裂縫及滲水紀錄。記錄核心表面溫度及同條件試體成熟度，將裂縫位置與溫差、拆模及鄰段澆置時間配對，檢查熱歷程是否被遺漏。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Pair surface and internal temperatures with cracking and leakage records. Record core/surface temperature and matched-cured maturity, pairing cracks with temperature differences, formwork removal and adjacent pours to identify missing thermal history. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 熱應力式不能單獨預測凍融剝落，兩機制不可混用。標準養護試體合格而現場過早冷卻，仍可能形成貫穿裂縫並影響止水；僅增加後續抗壓試驗無法重建失去的養護。~Thermal-stress equations alone cannot predict freeze-thaw scaling. Passing standard-cured specimens does not prevent through-cracking after rapid cooling, and more later strength tests cannot reconstruct inadequate curing.
units.misconception: 混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。~Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks.
units.practice: 本案「拘束溫度應變」的交付需回答：將表面與內部溫度配對裂縫及滲水紀錄。澆置前核准溫度監測及養護方案，變更材料、拆模或澆置順序時重新檢查熱分析，將裂縫與接縫止水的責任一併交付。~For Great St Bernard Tunnel, the restrained thermal strain handover must address the following evidence: Pair surface and internal temperatures with cracking and leakage records. Approve monitoring and curing before pours, revisit thermal analysis after material or sequence changes, and hand over crack and waterstop responsibilities together.

units.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓~Piezometric head and lining pressure
units.mechanism: 高山融雪補注和道路帶入水需分流判讀，研究聖伯納山背景下排水增量是否跟隨季節或車流。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。~Separate snowmelt recharge and road-carried water, checking whether drainage changes follow season or traffic. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
units.model: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=82 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=804.42 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為884.862 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=82 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=804.42 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 884.862 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 對照融雪期、降雨和車流時序的水量。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare flow with snowmelt, rainfall and traffic histories. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 車輛帶入水若當地下水增壓會誤導襯砌判讀。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。~Road-carried water misclassified as rising groundwater misleads lining assessment. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.
units.misconception: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。~No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
units.practice: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：對照融雪期、降雨和車流時序的水量。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。~For Great St Bernard Tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Compare flow with snowmelt, rainfall and traffic histories. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

units.anchor: 擴散特徵長度~Diffusion characteristic length
units.title: 氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀~Chloride transport and durability interpretation
units.mechanism: 除冰鹽帶入的暴露可能集中於路側低區，不能以高處乾燥取樣代表整個斷面。海水或除冰鹽可提供氯離子，材料孔隙與裂縫控制其傳輸；鋼筋腐蝕還需要局部電化學條件。平方根擴散長度僅顯示時間尺度，並不是腐蝕門檻深度；表面濃度變化、乾濕循環、結合效應及施工裂縫須另行辨識。~Deicing-salt exposure can concentrate near low roadside zones, so dry high-level samples do not represent the section. Seawater or deicing salt supplies chloride, while pores and cracks govern transport; reinforcement corrosion also depends on local electrochemical conditions. A square-root diffusion length indicates a time scale, not a corrosion-threshold depth. Surface concentration, wetting cycles, binding and construction cracks must be distinguished rather than hidden in one fitted diffusivity.
units.model: 原創教學假設：擴散係數=1e-12 m²/s；暴露時間=15 year。ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=21.7569 mm。僅把暴露時間增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為22.8189 mm。邊界：特徵長度，不是腐蝕起始壽命或氯鹽門檻深度；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: diffusivity=1e-12 m²/s; exposure=15 year. ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=21.7569 mm. Increasing only exposure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 22.8189 mm. Boundary: Characteristic length, not corrosion-initiation life or chloride-threshold depth. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 按高度與距車道位置比較氯鹽、含水及裂縫。以分層取樣的氯鹽剖面配合裂縫圖與電位量測，檢查擴散模型是否只適用未開裂材料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare chloride, moisture and cracks by height and distance from traffic. Combine depth-resolved chloride samples with crack maps and potential measurements, checking whether the diffusion model applies only to uncracked material. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 採樣位置偏乾會系統性低估易濕區劣化。把一次電位讀值當腐蝕速率會誤判剩餘壽命，裂縫快速傳輸也可能被平均材料係數掩蓋。~Sampling dry locations systematically understates deterioration in wet zones. Treating one potential reading as corrosion rate misjudges remaining life, while averaged material coefficients conceal rapid crack transport.
units.misconception: 擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。~Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation.
units.practice: 本案「擴散特徵長度」的交付需回答：按高度與距車道位置比較氯鹽、含水及裂縫。保留取樣深度、含水狀態及材料批次，用多種證據解釋劣化；維修優先序依構件功能與實際病害制定。~For Great St Bernard Tunnel, the diffusion characteristic length handover must address the following evidence: Compare chloride, moisture and cracks by height and distance from traffic. Retain sample depth, moisture and material batches and interpret deterioration using multiple evidence types; prioritise repairs by function and observed defects.

units.anchor: 襯砌環向壓縮~Lining hoop compression
units.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度~Ring force and joint flexibility
units.mechanism: 既有襯砌修補前先辨認地層荷載、漏水與材料劣化，聖伯納山教材不把所有裂縫歸為強度不足。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。~Before lining repair, distinguish ground loading, leakage and material deterioration instead of treating all cracks as inadequate strength. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending. Thin-ring membrane stress describes only one load path. Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation.
units.model: 原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.54 MPa；半徑=3.6 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=5.55429 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為6.10971 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.54 MPa; radius=3.6 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=5.55429 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 6.10971 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 比較裂縫方向、季節開合與外水頭變化。將環形變形、接縫張開與應變和含接頭彈簧的模型比較，分開安裝後、背填後及水頭回升後的基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare crack orientation and seasonal opening against external head changes. Compare ring distortion, joint opening and strain with a joint-spring model, separating baselines after installation, grouting and head recovery. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 表面補縫而未辨認持續變形會反覆出現同類病害。局部脫空增加環片彎曲，裂縫未必代表混凝土平均強度不足；忽略接縫接觸會把補強方向導向錯誤位置。~Surface sealing without identifying continuing movement leads to recurrent defects. Local voids increase bending, so cracks need not indicate inadequate mean concrete strength; neglecting joint contact can misdirect strengthening.
units.misconception: 混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。~Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
units.practice: 本案「襯砌環向壓縮」的交付需回答：比較裂縫方向、季節開合與外水頭變化。設計圖應分開標註各施工階段、接頭剛度及背填條件，構件驗收同時核對幾何、材料批次與止水試驗適用包絡。~For Great St Bernard Tunnel, the lining hoop compression handover must address the following evidence: Compare crack orientation and seasonal opening against external head changes. Drawings distinguish stages, joint stiffness and backfill conditions; component acceptance reconciles geometry, material batches and the applicable sealing-test envelope.

units.anchor: 所需疏散時間~Required evacuation time
units.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性~Evacuation time and zone availability
units.mechanism: 雙向交通中事故兩側使用者位置不同，教學路徑分別處理回頭、停車與前方阻隔情境。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。~Users lie on different sides of an incident in bidirectional traffic; distinguish turnaround, stopped queues and blocked-forward-path cases. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit. Smoke, visibility and mobility alter walking speed, while safety requires comparison with available safe time. A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route.
units.model: 原創教學假設：前置時間=104 s；行走距離=340 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=529 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為571.5 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=104 s; travel distance=340 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=529 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 571.5 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 用不同起始位置測試通道及訊息可見性。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Test passage availability and message visibility from different starting positions. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 假設所有人都朝同一出口會漏掉事故位置造成的阻隔。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。~Assuming everyone uses one exit ignores obstruction by incident location. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard.
units.misconception: 只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。~Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
units.practice: 本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：用不同起始位置測試通道及訊息可見性。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。~For Great St Bernard Tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Test passage availability and message visibility from different starting positions. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.

units.title: 設備備援與共同失效~Equipment redundancy and common failure
units.mechanism: 兩端控制室可提高監督能力，但共用通訊或電源仍會造成共同故障，研究控制權交接證據。兩套設備只有在故障近似獨立且切換可靠時，並聯才顯著降低不可用率。共用配電、控制軟體、冷卻或受淹位置會把獨立假設破壞；維修停用也改變當下配置，因此可靠度模型必須明列共有資源和設備狀態，不能只數備用台數。~Two control rooms improve supervision but shared communication or power can still fail; examine evidence for authority transfer. Parallel equipment sharply reduces unavailability only when failures are approximately independent and transfer works. Shared power, software, cooling or flood exposure breaks that assumption. Planned maintenance also changes the available configuration, so reliability models must identify shared resources and states rather than count spare units or multiply unsupported independent probabilities.
units.model: 原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.022 無因次。Uparallel=U²=0.000484 probability。僅把單機不可用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.00058564 probability。邊界：完全獨立並聯與完美切換，不含共同失效；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.022 dimensionless. Uparallel=U²=0.000484 probability. Increasing only single-unit unavailability by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.00058564 probability. Boundary: Independent parallel units with perfect transfer, excluding common failures. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 測試主從切換並追查共用鏈路與時間同步。由設備清單畫出故障樹，將電源、控制及實體位置追到共同節點，並用事件及維修紀錄檢查獨立假設。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Test authority transfer and trace shared links and time synchronisation. Build a fault tree from the asset list, trace power, control and location to shared nodes, and test independence against incident and maintenance records. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 兩室畫面一致不證明資料鏈路或電源相互獨立。重複安裝卻共用單一供電可能在一次故障中全部停機，帳面可靠度很高但實際不可用時間沒有降低。~Matching displays do not prove independent data links or power. Duplicated equipment on one supply can fail together in a single event, leaving actual downtime unchanged despite optimistic calculated reliability.
units.misconception: 設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。~Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
units.practice: 本案「系統不可用率」的交付需回答：測試主從切換並追查共用鏈路與時間同步。維修計畫附當日可用配置與剩餘備援，任何共同資源更動同步更新故障樹，切換試驗由設備及營運團隊共同見證。~For Great St Bernard Tunnel, the system unavailability handover must address the following evidence: Test authority transfer and trace shared links and time synchronisation. Attach the actual configuration and remaining redundancy to maintenance plans, update fault trees after shared-resource changes, and witness transfer tests jointly.

units.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接~Asset identity and traceable handover
units.mechanism: 跨境維修需讓兩種語言的設備清單對應同一位置和工單，研究名詞翻譯與唯一識別碼分離。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。~Cross-border maintenance needs multilingual inventories linked to one location and work order, separating translated names from unique identifiers. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
units.model: 原創教學假設：設備總數=112 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.7143 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為84.2857 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: asset count=112 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.7143 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 84.2857 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 抽查兩控制室對同一告警的定位及維修責任。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check both rooms locate one alarm identically and assign the same maintenance responsibility. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 同名設備位於不同洞端時，文字翻譯不能取代位置編碼。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。~Translation cannot replace location codes when similarly named assets occupy opposite portals. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.
units.misconception: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。~Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
units.practice: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽查兩控制室對同一告警的定位及維修責任。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。~For Great St Bernard Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Check both rooms locate one alarm identically and assign the same maintenance responsibility. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

example: 原創綜合審查：先計算「通風網路與壓力損失」，再獨立計算「氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀」。原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=980 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.1 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=35.3168 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為42.7333 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：擴散係數=1e-12 m²/s；暴露時間=15 year。ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=21.7569 mm。僅把暴露時間增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為22.8189 mm。邊界：特徵長度，不是腐蝕起始壽命或氯鹽門檻深度；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。~Original integrated review: first calculate ventilation network and pressure loss, then independently calculate chloride transport and durability interpretation. Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=980 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.1 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=35.3168 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 42.7333 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: diffusivity=1e-12 m²/s; exposure=15 year. ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=21.7569 mm. Increasing only exposure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 22.8189 mm. Boundary: Characteristic length, not corrosion-initiation life or chloride-threshold depth. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
history: 1964 年公開記錄：聖伯納山公路隧道於3月正式開通。聖伯納山隧道營運者列長5798公尺，並說明兩端高山入口與全天有人值守的控制室。1964年開通的背景使其適合學習既有公路隧道長期更新。本課將洞口氣候、雙向車流、通風、耐久及跨境資訊交接串成完整工程問題，避免把洞內性能與引道服務切割。本課把「高山入口、雙向交通與雙控制室協調」視為互相連動的系統，工程年代和名稱由所列公開來源核對；模型中的設備配置、荷載與量測數字另外標明為教學假設，只重建公開原理及工程推理，不是原始設計文件。~Public record for 1964: The Great St Bernard road tunnel officially opens in March. The operator describes a 5798 m tunnel with high-altitude portals and continuously staffed control rooms at both ends. Its 1964 opening provides a setting for long-term renewal of an existing road tunnel. The course connects portal climate, bidirectional traffic, ventilation, durability and cross-border information handover rather than isolating tunnel performance from approach service. The course treats alpine portals, bidirectional traffic and control-room coordination as coupled engineering questions. Named events and dimensions follow the listed public sources; equipment scenarios, loads and measurement values are separately marked teaching assumptions. Only public principles and reasoning are reconstructed, not original design documents.
facts: 公開工程尺度約為 5798 m，保留所列來源的計量邊界。~The public scale is about 5798 m; retain the measurement boundary in the cited source.
1964 年事件：聖伯納山公路隧道於3月正式開通。~1964 event: The Great St Bernard road tunnel officially opens in March.

教學「路線里程與端點」：長度=16.8 km，其餘輸入依單元，結果=16.8 min；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching alignment chainage and endpoints: length=16.8 km, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 16.8 min; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「風道摩擦壓損」：達西因子=0.025 無因次，其餘輸入依單元，結果=35.3168 Pa；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching duct friction loss: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 35.3168 Pa; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「測壓水頭」：水密度=1000 kg/m³，其餘輸入依單元，結果=804.42 kPa；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching piezometric head: water density=1000 kg/m³, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 804.42 kPa; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「擴散特徵長度」：擴散係數=1e-12 m²/s，其餘輸入依單元，結果=21.7569 mm；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching diffusion characteristic length: diffusivity=1e-12 m²/s, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 21.7569 mm; not measured or accepted project data.
